name: podverse
description: Podverse monorepo - podcast app infrastructure, modules, and applications

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/helpers && npm run build -w packages/helpers-validation && npm run build -w packages/parser-mapping && npm run build -w packages/helpers-requests && npm run build -w packages/helpers-backend && npm run build -w packages/helpers-browser && npm run build -w packages/helpers-config && npm run build -w packages/external-services-firebase && npm run build -w packages/external-services-paypal && npm run build -w packages/external-services-podcast-index && npm run build -w packages/orm && npm run build -w packages/notifications && npm run build -w packages/parser && npm run build -w packages/mq
scripts.build:packages:prod: npm run build:prod -w packages/helpers && npm run build:prod -w packages/helpers-validation && npm run build:prod -w packages/parser-mapping && npm run build:prod -w packages/helpers-requests && npm run build:prod -w packages/helpers-backend && npm run build:prod -w packages/helpers-browser && npm run build:prod -w packages/helpers-config && npm run build:prod -w packages/external-services-firebase && npm run build:prod -w packages/external-services-paypal && npm run build:prod -w packages/external-services-podcast-index && npm run build:prod -w packages/orm && npm run build:prod -w packages/notifications && npm run build:prod -w packages/parser && npm run build:prod -w packages/mq
scripts.clean:packages: find packages -name 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo' -delete && find packages -type d -name 'dist' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.clean:apps: find apps -name 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo' -delete && find apps -type d \( -name 'dist' -o -name '.next' -o -name '.cache' -o -name 'compiled' \) -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:packages && npm run clean:apps
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean:node_modules && rm -f package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.reinstall:full: npm run clean:all && npm run reinstall && npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.watch:packages: concurrently -n helpers,h-valid,h-map,h-req,h-back,h-brow,h-conf,ext-fb,ext-pay,ext-pi,orm,notif,parser,mq -c blue,yellow,green,magenta,cyan,green,red,blueBright,greenBright,magentaBright,cyanBright,yellowBright,gray,red "npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers" "sleep 1 && npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers-validation" "sleep 2 && npm run build:watch -w packages/parser-mapping" "sleep 3 && npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers-requests" "sleep 4 && npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers-backend" "sleep 5 && npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers-browser" "sleep 6 && npm run build:watch -w packages/helpers-config" "sleep 7 && npm run build:watch -w packages/external-services-firebase" "sleep 8 && npm run build:watch -w packages/external-services-paypal" "sleep 9 && npm run build:watch -w packages/external-services-podcast-index" "sleep 10 && npm run build:watch -w packages/orm" "sleep 13 && npm run build:watch -w packages/notifications" "sleep 16 && npm run build:watch -w packages/parser" "sleep 19 && npm run build:watch -w packages/mq"
scripts.dev:main:all: concurrently -n pkg,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run watch:packages" "sleep 21 && npm run dev:api:watch" "sleep 27 && npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:management:all: concurrently -n pkg,mgmt-api,mgmt-web -c gray,magentaBright,greenBright "npm run watch:packages" "sleep 21 && npm run dev:management-api:watch" "sleep 27 && npm run dev:management-web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n pkg,api,web,mgmt-api,mgmt-web -c gray,blue,green,magentaBright,greenBright "npm run watch:packages" "sleep 21 && npm run dev:api:watch" "sleep 27 && npm run dev:web" "sleep 33 && npm run dev:management-api:watch" "sleep 39 && npm run dev:management-web"
scripts.lint: npm run type-check && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run prettier:check
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspaces --if-present && npm run prettier:write
scripts.i18n:compile: npm run i18n-compile -w apps/web && npm run i18n-compile -w apps/management-web
scripts.i18n:translate: npm run i18n-llm-translations -w apps/web && npm run i18n-llm-translations -w apps/management-web
scripts.i18n:all: npm run i18n:translate && npm run i18n:compile
